title: A Nested Doll-velopement: Fire Mutant
description: A Nested Doll-velopement: Fire Mutant — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 5, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill the Fire Mutant Nesting Dolls to Collect the Fire Mutant Nested Doll in the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 5, then return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

It seems I'm having a little more trouble figuring out how to market the Fire Mutant Nested Doll than I am with the ice Whisker Nested Doll. You see, if I use the Fire Mutant Nested Doll for storage it just incinerates whatever I put into it. I did notice that, if I put them in my cottage, it will warm the cottage up. That has to be the most useless thing ever! If I want my cottage warm I will spend hours chopping wood, starting a fire, and hovering around it until I am nice and toasty. The Dungeon Runners of Townston don't want convenience, they want magic!

It would be nice to have an extra set of Fire Mutant Nested Dolls to tinker with, and that is why you are here. Make your way to the Gulag's Solitary Confinement - Wing B, located off of Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 in Ratsputin'g Gulag Level 5. When you are there kill the Ice Whisker Nesting Dolls to collect the Ice Whisker Nested Doll. Return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston when you are done.

Turn-in:

I see you made it back in one piece. You have the doll, don't you?

Objectives:

  • Fire Mutant Nested Doll ×1

Client level range: 90–100
